tools.name: get_golf_trip_details
tools.description: Get editorial details and Itsy departures for one Golfskálinn golf trip slug returned by search_golf_trips. Does not reserve seats, submit an enquiry, or book travel.

slug.description: Exact trip slug returned by search_golf_trips.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get public details for one Golfskálinn product ID returned by search_products. Does not add the product to a cart or place an order.

product_id.description: Exact product ID returned by search_products.

tools.name: search_golf_trips
tools.description: Search Golfskálinn golf trips by destination, theme, or category. Returns Itsy departure and price readings with the matching travel page. Final availability is confirmed when booking; this does not hold seats.

query.description: Destination, resort, trip, or golf theme.

category.description: Trip category: destination, school, special, or wellness.

limit.description: Results to return, up to five.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search or browse Golfskálinn products. Returns indexed catalogue prices, stock flags that can change, and product links, and shows the same filters on the page.

query.description: Words from the product name or use.

in_stock.description: Set true for products marked in stock; false does not filter.

on_sale.description: Set true for products marked on sale; false does not filter.

limit.description: Results to return, up to five.
